title: PDF Document preview displayed compressed binary artifacts on upload
description:
1. Navigated to Doc Nexus creative suite
2. Clicked 'Browse Document' and chose multi-page quarterly_report.pdf
3. The document ingested but text blocks contained scrambled glyphs and Flate-encoded symbols instead of readable text.

environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

capturedLogs.message: Raw binary regular expression detected FlateDecode streams without decompressor hook
Font CMap glyph decoding anomaly detected during text extraction

expectedBehavior: PDF should render legible text lines with high-resolution visual previews.
actualBehavior: Garbled characters and uncompressed binary stream artifacts appeared.
adminNotes: Root cause identified: Raw regex parser lacked zlib FlateDecode. Resolved via Mozilla PDF.js v6.4 integration in release v0.3.0.

title: Browse Document modal icon background too dark in light theme
description: When switching the main application to Light Theme, the 'Browse Document' button in the Open Local Workspace modal retains a dark black background (bg-slate-900), creating visual contrast issues with other tonal elements.
expectedBehavior: Icon container should use brand-aligned light container with indigo styling (bg-indigo-50).
